FN-L5IESAA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 181
Committee: Ports, Waterways, and Intermodal Transit Sponsor: Representative Rhett Marques
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/14/2026
House Bill 181 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama Port Authority by
an estimated $65 million annually, according to estimates by the authority for increased
transportation costs to follow new guidelines for the beneficial use of dredging materials, as
provided by this bill. This bill could further increase the obligations of the authority by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the costs associated with constructing additional
containment sites for beneficial use projects, as provided in the bill.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Conservation
and Natural Resources and the Department of Environmental Management to adopt rules to
implement the provisions of this bill.
Page 1

FN-L5IESAA-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 181
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Rhett Marques
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/22/2026
House Bill 181 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund could increase
the obligations of the Alabama Port Authority by an undetermined amount dependent on the
amount of increased costs to comply with the guidelines for the beneficial use of dredging
materials, as provided by this bill; however, compliance with this bill is contingent on the
allocation and availability of federal funds for such purpose and the availability of beneficial use
sites.
This bill further prohibits the use of funds appropriated from the State General Fund for
expenses incurred to comply with this bill.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Conservation
and Natural Resources and the Department of Environmental Management to adopt rules to
implement the provisions of this bill.
